svg.title: TYPE_CHARGE_PAYLOAD -> ExpandChargePayloadJob()
svg.desc: Charge an electric car. If its tray is not already on a ready VECS, find one, plan the tray move, then switch the VECS to CHARGING.
svg.metadata: ["Start: the request arrives. The map is working_state as the method first sees it; no events yet. Step through the method one table row at a time.", "Row 1. Make a scratch copy of the request's garage and apply every event already in the DAG, so the method sees the garage as earlier jobs will leave it. A replay that fails fails the job. In this example: Empty DAG. (replay)", "Row 2. Find the car and the tray it is on. In this example: The car is on T20 at P20. (found)", "Row 3. If the tray already sits on an EV charging node whose VECS is ready, no move is needed. In this example: P20 is plain parking. (no)", "Row 4. Otherwise search for a reachable VECS spot, reusing the open-space search of ResolveBlockingTrays. In this example: The open-space search only accepts a spot with a VECS for an EV-charge payload (OpenSpaceSearchEnvironment): V23 here. (dest = V23)", "Row 5. The search must have found a node, and that node must have a VECS (an EV_CHARGE node). In this example: V23 is a VECS. (passes)", "Row 6. Plan the tray onto the VECS (reuses ExpandReparkTrayJob). In this example: Adds the TrayMove with AddChainedEvent (T20); OrderAfterBayAndChargerEvents would wait for V23's last event (none yet). (adds 1)", "Row 7. Start charging once the tray is there. In this example: Starts after the tray arrives. (adds 2 \u00b7 1 -> 2)", "Playing the plan (one illustrative execution: AGV assignment and motion planning choose the real AGV and route): AGV-1 drives empty W26 -> W27 -> P24 -> P20 and stops under T20 (the approach for event 1; AGV assignment adds such moves later).", "Playing the plan: event 1. AGV-1 lifts T20, carries it P20 -> P19 -> P23 and lowers it.", "Playing the plan: event 2. V23 switches to CHARGING. The car on T20 is charging. Every tray and AGV is now where the plan leaves it."]
